# PushAlert

Send and manage Web Push notifications, subscriber segments, attributes, and automation for a PushAlert website project.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/push-alert/.

## Actions

- **Add Subscribers to Segment**: Add one or more Web Push subscribers to an existing segment.
- **Create Segment**: Create a Web Push subscriber segment with a letters-and-digits name.
- **Delete Segment**: Permanently delete a Web Push subscriber segment by ID.
- **Get Notification Stats** (read-only): Get attempted, delivered, clicked, and click-through-rate statistics for a Web Push notification.
- **Get Subscriber Attributes** (read-only): Get custom attributes for a Web Push subscriber.
- **List Segments** (read-only): List all Web Push subscriber segments and their subscriber counts.
- **Remove Subscribers from Segment**: Remove one or more Web Push subscribers from an existing segment.
- **Send Web Push Notification**: Send an irreversible Web Push notification to a saved segment, explicit subscriber IDs, or attribute-matched subscribers.
- **Set Subscriber Attributes**: Add or update custom attributes for a Web Push subscriber.
